title: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
source: curated summary - authentic text at the India Code URL
note: In force from 1 July 2024. Replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

sections.heading: Information in cognizable cases
sections.text: Registration of a First Information Report, including zero FIR and electronic registration. Corresponds to section 154 CrPC.

sections.heading: Police officer's power to investigate cognizable case
sections.text: Corresponds to section 156 CrPC, including the magistrate's power to order investigation.

sections.heading: Procedure when investigation cannot be completed in 24 hours
sections.text: Remand provisions. Corresponds to section 167 CrPC.

sections.heading: Report of police officer on completion of investigation
sections.text: The charge-sheet. Corresponds to section 173 CrPC.

sections.heading: Examination of complainant
sections.text: Corresponds to section 200 CrPC; adds a mandatory hearing for the accused before cognizance on a complaint.

sections.heading: Maximum period of detention of undertrial prisoner
sections.text: Corresponds to section 436A CrPC, with a stricter regime for first-time offenders.

sections.heading: Anticipatory bail
sections.text: Direction for release on bail to a person apprehending arrest. Corresponds to section 438 CrPC.

sections.heading: Inherent powers of the High Court
sections.text: Corresponds to section 482 CrPC - the quashing jurisdiction.
